build-railway-between-two-cities-title: Build a direct railway from {{fromStation}} to {{toStation}}
build-railway-between-two-cities-descrip: There's been an increase in goods exchange from <station>{{fromStation}}</station> to <station>{{toStation}}</station>, building a direct railway between both those cities and creating a <important>direct freight</important> line may be very fruitful!
tutorial-direct-railway-title: Tutorial #1 - Building a railroad line between two cities
tutorial-direct-railway-description:
Welcome to Logistik!

In this game, you run a railroad company. Your goal is to grow your business by building railroad tracks and connecting stations with trains.

To get started, I’d like you to build a line between {{fromStation}} and {{toStation}}. To do this, use the "Railway" tool in the toolbar on the left (or the R key on your keyboard), then click on the two stations.

Note: When building a railroad track, try avoiding landscape features such as forests or rivers. They increase the cost of building the track!
tutorial-planned-rolling-stock-descripti:
Now that {{fromStation}} and {{toStation}} are connected by a railroad line, it's time to run a train!

To do this, open the train scheduler in the left toolbar (or press the P key on your keyboard). Once the interface is open, click {{fromStation}} and then {{toStation}}. Finally, click the "Create" button.
tutorial-buy-rolling-stock-title: Tutorial #3 - You're out of rolling stock, buy more!
tutorial-buy-rolling-stock-description:
It looks like you're out of rolling stock. How much is used, the total available and to buy more, check the panel on the bottom left of the screen.

By clicking the "+" button, you can manage your current rolling stock.

Buy more and come back to us!
